title: Starter tables before data play
summary: Before looking up types or screening, download the five starter tables from tutorial 2.0. Daily bars need symbols and dates. This is not a table catalog.
narrative:
Before you look up DataTypes or screen a pool, fill a small local starter set. Tutorial 2.0 names five tables: trade_calendar, stock_basic, index_basic, index_daily (a benchmark such as 000300.SH), and stock_daily (a few example stocks). Daily bar tables need share codes and an explicit start and end.

This is a starter set for data play, not a catalog of every built-in table. Other tables come after you look up the information ID, and they still need dates when they are time series. Periodic refresh is still refill_data_source; this card does not teach a scheduler script.

If a lookup returns an id but a read comes back empty, the usual cause is that these starter tables or that date window were never downloaded. Check the local overview next.
python_code:
import qteasy as qt
qt.refill_data_source(tables='trade_calendar, stock_basic, index_basic')
qt.refill_data_source(tables='index_daily', symbols='000300.SH', start_date='20220101', end_date='20221231')
qt.refill_data_source(tables='stock_daily', symbols='000001.SZ, 600519.SH', start_date='20220101', end_date='20221231')
risk_notes: Naming the five starter tables is not permission to download the whole market without dates.
